source: 国土地理院 地理院タイル 全国最新写真（シームレス）・標高タイルDEM10B
sourceDateNote: PLATEAU buildings are 2020; live GSI DEM and seamless imagery can have different capture/update dates. Download times are not acquisition dates. DEM orthometric heights can differ from 2020 city terrain.

coreExclusion.type: exact rectangle clipping at original Mesh-004 x/z bounding box
coreExclusion.note: The original terrain footprint is not guaranteed to be exactly rectangular. Small boundary gaps are possible; no full grid cell is discarded.

groundGrid: 17 by 17 per z14 source tile, source latitude/longitude projected into the original Unity coordinate system
elevationNoDataPolicy: Live terrain fails to load if a vertex has no valid DEM sample; partial bilinear samples are renormalized and reported, never silently filled with zero
